limit.description: The number of lines to read. Use 0 to use the default limit.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Use an empty string for non-PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Use 0 to start at the beginning.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.
